nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 布鲁克林的午后，Marcus 在唱片店门口等你，脖子上挂着那台老宾得。

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: Yo! Right on time. Today I'm showing you the realest museum in New York. No tickets needed.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 他带你钻进了地铁站。晚高峰前的站台，光线从格栅间斜切下来。

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: The subway, my man. Eight million stories a day, and nobody's posing. That's why I shoot here.

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: Real question. I shoot hands, shoes, reflections - never faces without asking. Respect first, photo second. Always.

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: A'ight, watch. You don't hunt the shot, you wait for it. Like fishing, but the fish is light.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 一列 Q 线进站，气流掀起报纸。Marcus 半蹲下来，快门轻响了一声。

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: Got it. An old man's hands holding a bag of oranges. That's somebody's whole Sunday right there.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 他把相机递给你，示意你也试一张。取景框里，城市忽然变得很慢。

options.text: 拍下站台尽头拉小提琴的艺人
拍下并排睡着的一对母女

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: The busker? Nice eye. Music you can see - that's a real New York picture, no cap.

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: Oh that's tender, for real. The city moves fast but people still find a place to rest. You got the eye.

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: You know what my grandma says? "The city talks with its hands." That's the name of my show one day.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 走出地铁站时天已经擦黑，热狗摊的蒸汽混着黄昏的光。Marcus 请你吃了这顿——作为你当他一下午助手的报酬。

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: Next time we hit the Brooklyn Bridge at golden hour. Bring comfortable shoes, we're walking the whole thing.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 你翻看着相机背屏里自己拍的第一张纽约照片，突然有点懂他说的『最真实的博物馆』了。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 【获得 100 金币】纽约的故事，定格在第一张快门里。
